posts.post:
Friendly reminder that fast fashion is designed to fall apart so you stay poor and distracted.

True style begins when you stop buying clothes that have an expiration date.

How to know if you have a good wardrobe: you can close your eyes, pull out two pieces, and they still make sense together.

If you have to think this hard, you are just collecting clutter.

Fun fact: people don't respect your outfit because it is trendy.

They respect it because it looks like you actually put thought into your existence.
